# Button art (CC0)

The button icons Savage Wind ships for Options > Gameplay > Sharper buttons (`runtime/nvn/glyphs.c`). They come from
the free [Input Prompts Pack](https://juliocacko.itch.io/free-input-prompts) by JulioCacko, whose itch.io page says:
"License: CC0 1.0 Universal. Free to use in any project, commercial or non-commercial. No attribution required (but
appreciated!)." ([CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)). The download itself has no license
file.

Only the 150 pictures the game can ask for are here, unchanged and in the pack's own folders and file names (from its
`Source.zip`, downloaded 2026-11-16):

| Folder | Used for |
|---|---|
| `XGamepad/Default` | Xbox buttons; Steam Deck letters and menu buttons |
| `P5Gamepad/Default` | PlayStation buttons; Steam Deck shoulders and sticks |
| `Keyboard_Mouse/Dark` | keys and the mouse |

They ship next to the executable as `button-art/`. A player who wants other art can put a pack with the same layout in
`prompt-art/` in the data folder: it is used instead.
